sentences.text: The Writ Petition stands ordered only insofar as sealing of the premises is concerned.
The respondents are directed to de-seal the premises forthwith.
This order will not stand in the way of the respondents to prosecute the petitioner in F.I.R. No.75 of 2024 on the file of the third respondent for the alleged offences committed by him.
Consequently, connected Miscellaneous Petitions are closed.

opennyai_summary.decision:
The Writ Petition stands ordered only insofar as sealing of the premises is concerned.
The respondents are directed to de-seal the premises forthwith.
This order will not stand in the way of the respondents to prosecute the petitioner in F.I.R. No.75 of 2024 on the file of the third respondent for the alleged offences committed by him.
Consequently, connected Miscellaneous Petitions are closed.
